author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: AAEON announced that full mainline Linux support for the 40-pin Raspberry Pi-compatible GPIO header on its UP Squared series has been merged into Linux 6.18. The work, completed in collaboration with Bootlin, removes the need for the previously required out-of-tree DKMS driver.
